summary: The study evaluates the use of PEALD SiN as a spacer material for high-k metal gate integration in transistors. PEALD SiN shows improved material quality, conformality, and resistance to wet etches compared to PECVD SiN. The process uses trisilylamine and H2/N2 RF plasma at temperatures between 300 ◦C and 400◦C. The results indicate that PEALD SiN provides better electrical properties and device performance due to its superior conformality and pattern density behavior.
